newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stock market closed; trading to resume Jan 3.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stock market closed; trading to resume Jan 3.

text.p: The Seoul stock market is closed for trading from Saturday until January 2 for year-end clearance of transactions and the New Year holidays, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Saturday.
Trading will resume on January 3, but only for a two-hour session from 11.00 a.m. (0200 GMT), instead of the usual two two-hour sessions starting at 9.30 a.m. (0030 GMT), an exchange spokesman said.
